description: The markers already on this Mixpanel project's charts (launches, campaigns, incidents) with their date, text, tags and who wrote them. READ THESE BEFORE EXPLAINING A CHANGE IN A CHART: an annotation is an explanation somebody already wrote down. fromDate / toDate (YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive) narrow the window. Read-only, 0 credits. Needs Mixpanel connected.
name: list_mixpanel_annotations
title: List Mixpanel annotations
